newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 JUMPS AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 JUMPS AT FIXING.

text.p: The Czech PX50 surged at Wednesday's fixing ahead of an expected government announcement of a range of new measures to stimulate the economy, cut the trade deficit and restore confidence to the markets.
The PX50 was boosted by strong gains to SPT Telecom which rose 101 crowns to 3,481 and Komercni Banka which gained 66 crowns to 2,271.
The government is widely expected to announce, as part of the package, the quick establishment of a U.S. style securities and exchange commission to oversee the capital markets.
